audited_exclusions.headline: Russian drones kill people around Kyiv and other regions
audited_exclusions.reason: Reuters describes continued intensive attacks in an already-active barrage. The frozen law requires a material change in the risk channel; the next day's unusually persistent jet-drone escalation is separately admitted.

audited_exclusions.headline: Russia says it struck military infrastructure and vessels in Ukraine
audited_exclusions.reason: Operational continuation of the same active strike campaign; no separately identified material policy/risk-channel change.

audited_exclusions.headline: Taiwan transfers senior naval commander to Coast Guard to boost deterrence coordination
audited_exclusions.reason: Official personnel/coordination change, but bounded source review did not establish a material change in the active cross-strait risk channel under the frozen admission rule.

audited_exclusions.headline: Middle East oil exports rise while tanker attacks increase
audited_exclusions.reason: Retrospective shipping/flow synthesis describing already-recorded tanker risk, not a new first-disclosure geopolitical event.

bounded_source_audit.note: This is a bounded audit, not a universal world-news completeness claim. Oct 6 remains open and uncertified until the next UTC midnight.

parent_cluster_dependence.purpose: Preserve row-level admissions while preventing repeated developments in one campaign from being treated as independent scientific proof.
parent_cluster_dependence.note: Four conservative parent clusters is a dependence disclosure, not an effective sample-size estimate.

future_accrual_safeguard.operational_rule: Before opening any future row's U.S. leg, complete and persist a bounded source-only family sweep through that row's admission window, record candidate exclusions and exact clocks, then measure only rows already in that frozen source receipt.
future_accrual_safeguard.rationale: Prevents recurrence of the observed source-recall failure without tuning the frozen scientific hypothesis.
